sources.title: KordAI/III-BERT · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model repository must expose IIIBERTForSequenceClassification through the Transformers AutoModelForSequenceClassification mapping. If the published config.json currently maps only AutoConfig, AutoModel, and AutoModelForMaskedLM, add the sequence-classification mapping in the upload script and republish before using the example below.
